newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures start pit trade on downside.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures start pit trade on downside.

text.p: May 7 - U.S. debt futures started pit trade slightly lower. Nervousness ahead of the Treasury's 10-year note auction and the Fed's Beige Book at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT. June T-bonds eased to 109-24/32, while Sept Euros continued to hold above support at 93.83. Q1 productivity at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT seen rising 2.4 pct, from up 1.1 pct. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
